hooks.hint: Context-mode pre-tool hook — injects relevant context before tool use. Requires context-mode installed.
Context-mode post-tool hook — captures context after tool use. Requires context-mode installed.
Context-mode session start hook — initializes context for the session. Requires context-mode installed.
Context-mode stop hook — cleanup on session end. Requires context-mode installed.

Anti-slop audit hook — fires after edits to UI files (.tsx/.jsx/.vue/.svelte/.html/.css). Checks for .impeccable/config.json: if present, defers to impeccable's own two-speed design hooks (per-edit + end-of-session, DESIGN.md-aware); if absent, runs npx impeccable detect as fallback (if the npm package is available) or the orchestrator's audit mode (stop-slop + impeccable audit/critique). Safety net for the orchestrator's mandatory phase 3. Requires ui-design-orchestrator installed. Only active for hook-capable agents (devin/hermes/opencode/claude-code).

devin.notes: Devin reads AGENTS.md at project root. Project MCP at .devin/config.json (mcpServers key) — NOTE: since Devin v3000.3 the dedicated file is .devin/mcp_config.json (config.json mcpServers auto-migrates); move mcpConfigPath in a follow-up after checking installed versions. Hooks at .devin/hooks.v1.json (standalone). Also reads .windsurf/rules/ and .cursor/rules/ via read_config_from. Global MCP at ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json (shared with Windsurf). Specialist servers go to .devin/mcp_config.local.json with disabled:true (user enables per session: devin mcp enable <name> -s local) + agent defs in .devin/agents/.

hermes.notes: Hermes reads AGENTS.md. MCP config at .hermes/mcp.json. Hooks at .hermes/hooks.json. Skills from ~/.agents/skills (global, shared).

opencode.notes: opencode reads AGENTS.md. MCP config at .opencode/mcp.json — NOTE: docs describe opencode.json top-level 'mcp' key (with {type,command[],enabled} entries); the legacy .opencode/mcp.json path may be stale — verify against installed version before migrating. Hooks at .opencode/hooks.json. Skills from ~/.agents/skills (global, shared). Specialist servers are written to opencode.json 'mcp' (correct format) + global tools deny + .opencode/agents/<id>.md enable.

claude-code.notes: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md. MCP + hooks in .claude/settings.json. Skills from ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills.

cursor.notes: Cursor reads AGENTS.md natively (and .cursor/rules/*.md as complement). MCP config at .cursor/mcp.json. No hooks support. Skills from ~/.agents/skills (global).

windsurf.notes: Windsurf reads AGENTS.md natively (and .windsurf/rules/*.md as complement). MCP config at .windsurf/mcp_config.json. No hooks support. Skills from ~/.agents/skills and project .windsurf/skills.

omp.notes: omp (oh-my-pi) reads AGENTS.md at project root (a .omp/AGENTS.md override takes priority). Project MCP at .omp/mcp.json (mcpServers key). No declarative hooks: omp hooks are trusted TS/JS modules under .omp/hooks/pre|post/ (executable code), so the kit writes no hooks config. Rules are written to .omp/rules/ (kit convention; omp's native sticky-rules file is .omp/RULES.md). Skills discovered one level deep at user ~/.omp/agent/skills and project .omp/skills; ~/.agents/skills is also a compatible location. Caveat: omp auto-imports MCP definitions from other agents' configs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, plugins) and the first definition found wins — an omp+claude-code project must not double-register servers. Specialist profiles materialize as ~/.omp/profiles/<id>/agent/{mcp.json,AGENTS.md} invoked via omp --profile <id>; subagent tools: frontmatter CANNOT carry mcp__* patterns (built-ins only).
